# Prompt Log – Radon

Prompts of the Radon project (radon sensor data → analysis → dashboard). Work on the repository itself is in the general
log (`docs/PROMPT_LOG.md`). Prompt numbers are shared by all logs of the repo.
Token numbers are **measured** with `tools/token_usage.py`, which reads the Claude Code session log. Cross-check with `/cost`.

## #15 – 2026-11-17 – "Next project: analyse the radon sample data and show conclusions in a dashboard, on GitHub like NN"
- Questions (plan mode): no assignment PDF – the goal is a dashboard with correlations and meaningful, data-backed findings
  (night vs. day, closed windows, and more); folder `Radon/`; Python precomputes JSON, the page only draws it; the 20 MB CSV
  is moved to `Radon/data/` and committed.
- **Data:** 229k rows, 24 Mar – 13 Oct 2026, radon in 7 rooms (~10 min), CO₂/temperature/humidity/pressure in kitchen and
  bedroom, hourly weather incl. soil temperature.
- **Analysis** (`analysis/radon/`, pandas + SciPy): English column names, Vienna time; warm-up readings (uptime < 60 min) and
  0-dropouts between high readings removed (zeros in low rooms are real); one hourly grid; tests on one value per day.
  "Nobody at home" detected from flat CO₂ (1–5 Aug); zones found by clustering.
- **Findings that hold** (p < 0.01 and a relevant effect): nobody home → radon 5.5–8× in every room (70 % of all hours above
  300 Bq/m³ fall on these 5 days); night 0–6 h higher than afternoon 12–18 h in all rooms (up to +71 %, kitchen); airing
  (CO₂ drop ≥ 150 ppm) lowers radon in the next hours; high-CO₂ days have more radon (ρ = 0.38); two zones (living area vs.
  utility room & workshop, ρ within 0.68 vs. between 0.20); warm days: living area less radon, utility room & workshop more
  (follows soil temperature, ρ = 0.63); wind lowers radon in the utility room & workshop.
  **Not supported:** weekend vs. weekday, falling air pressure, humidity.
- **Dashboard** (`web/index.html`, `assets/dashboard.js`, plain SVG, DESIGN.md tokens): KPIs, room picker, daily series with
  min–max band, reference lines and empty-house shading, hourly profile, room comparison, one card per finding with its
  chart and statistic, driver × room correlation heat map, table, method notes. `log.html` = this log. Checked rendered in
  jsdom (no errors, no NaN) and as light/dark snapshots.
- Tests: `analysis/tests/test_analysis.py` (12: cleaning rules, each statistic on synthetic data with a known answer, real run).
- Files: `Radon/` (CLAUDE.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, pytest.ini, data/, analysis/, web/, docs/).
- **Tokens:** see the "By prompt" table (the running prompt is only partly counted there)
